name: GAN i Carry 4 3x3 (Magnetic) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i Carry 4 3x3 (Magnetic) – Bluetooth Smart Cube is a beginner-friendly smart speed cube that pairs smooth, reliable hardware with app-powered training. It tracks every turn with zero-loss sensing using durable magnetic induction sensors, then visualizes your solves so you can see where you’re improving (and what to fix next).
features: Learn faster with the app: Beginner course, master classes, and expert mentoring make improvement more structured.
Practice with real feedback: Track your speed and visualize your process with solve playback and data.
Race other cubers: 1v1 duels or team battles turn practice into competition.
Reliable smart tracking: Zero-loss sensing with magnetic induction sensors for accuracy and durability.
Long sessions, easy upkeep: Replaceable battery lasts about 150 hours.
Bluetooth smart cube connectivity: Syncs with the app for training, analysis, and racing modes.
